# 1 Chronicles Chapter 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 373r–374v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/1CH_006_page_001.jpg, 1CH_006_page_002.jpg, 1CH_006_page_003.jpg, 1CH_006_page_004.jpg

---

**6:1** The-sons of-Levi: Gershom, Qehat, and-Merari. **6:2** And-the-sons of-Qehat: Amram, Yitshar, and-Chevron, and-Uzzi'el. **6:3** And-the-children of-Amram: Aharon, and-Mosheh, and-Miryam. And-the-sons of-Aharon: Nadav, and-Avihu, El'azar, and-Itamar.

**6:4** El'azar fathered Pinechas, Pinechas fathered Avishu'a, **6:5** and-Avishu'a fathered Bukki, and-Bukki fathered Uzzi, **6:6** and-Uzzi fathered Zerachyah, and-Zerachyah fathered Merayot, **6:7** Merayot fathered Amaryah, and-Amaryah fathered Achituv, **6:8** and-Achituv fathered Tsadoq, and-Tsadoq fathered Achima'ats, **6:9** and-Achima'ats fathered Azaryah, and-Azaryah fathered Yochanan, **6:10** and-Yochanan fathered Azaryah — he [is] the-one-who-served-as-priest [hu asher kihen] in-the-house [ha-bayit] that Shelomoh built in-Yerushalayim.

**6:11** And-fathered Azaryah Amaryah, and-Amaryah fathered Achituv, **6:12** and-Achituv fathered Tsadoq, and-Tsadoq fathered Shallum, **6:13** and-Shallum fathered Chilqiyyah, and-Chilqiyyah fathered Azaryah, **6:14** and-Azaryah fathered Serayah, and-Serayah fathered Yehotsadaq. **6:15** And-Yehotsadaq went when-YHWH-exiled [behaglot YHWH] Yehudah and-Yerushalayim by-the-hand of-Nevukhadnetstsar.

**6:16** The-sons of-Levi: Gershom, Qehat, and-Merari. **6:17** And-these [are] the-names of-the-sons of-Gershom: Livni and-Shim'i. **6:18** And-the-sons of-Qehat: Amram, and-Yitshar, and-Chevron, and-Uzzi'el. **6:19** The-sons of-Merari: Machli and-Mushi. And-these [are] the-families of-the-Leviyyim according-to-their-fathers.

**6:20** Of-Gershom: Livni his-son, Yachat his-son, Zimmah his-son, **6:21** Yo'ach his-son, Iddo his-son, Zerach his-son, Ye'atrai his-son. **6:22** The-sons of-Qehat: Amminadav his-son, Qorach his-son, Assir his-son, **6:23** Elqanah his-son, and-Evyasaf his-son, and-Assir his-son, **6:24** Tachat his-son, Uri'el his-son, Uzziyyah his-son, and-Sha'ul his-son. **6:25** And-the-sons of-Elqanah: Amasai, and-Achimot, **6:26** Elqanah — the-sons of-Elqanah: Tsofai his-son, and-Nachat his-son, **6:27** Eli'av his-son, Yerocham his-son, Elqanah his-son. **6:28** And-the-sons of-Shemu'el: the-firstborn Vashni, and-Aviyyah.

**6:29** The-sons of-Merari: Machli, Livni his-son, Shim'i his-son, Uzzah his-son, **6:30** Shim'a his-son, Chaggiyyah his-son, Asayah his-son.

**6:31** And-these [are] whom David appointed [he'emid] over the-hands [yedei] of-song [shir] in-the-house of-YHWH, from the-resting [menuach] of-the-ark [ha-aron]. **6:32** And-they-were serving [meshartim] before the-dwelling [mishkan] of-the-tent of-meeting [ohel mo'ed] in-song [ba-shir], until the-building [benot] of-Shelomoh the-house of-YHWH in-Yerushalayim; and-they-stood according-to-their-order [ke-mishpatam] upon their-service [avoalatam].

**6:33** And-these [are] the-ones-standing and-their-sons: from the-sons of-the-Qehati, Heyman the-singer [ha-meshorer], son of-Yo'el, son of-Shemu'el, **6:34** son of-Elqanah, son of-Yerocham, son of-Eli'el, son of-To'ach, **6:35** son of-Tsuf, son of-Elqanah, son of-Machat, son of-Amasai, **6:36** son of-Elqanah, son of-Yo'el, son of-Azaryah, son of-Tsefanyah, **6:37** son of-Tachat, son of-Assir, son of-Evyasaf, son of-Qorach, **6:38** son of-Yitshar, son of-Qehat, son of-Levi, son of-Yisra'el.

**6:39** And-his-brother Asaf, the-one-standing at-his-right: Asaf son of-Berekhyahu, son of-Shim'a, **6:40** son of-Mikha'el, son of-Ba'aseyah, son of-Malkiyyah, **6:41** son of-Etni, son of-Zerach, son of-Adayah, **6:42** son of-Etan, son of-Zimmah, son of-Shim'i, **6:43** son of-Yachat, son of-Gershom, son of-Levi.

**6:44** And-the-sons of-Merari, their-brothers, on-the-left: Etan son of-Qishi, son of-Avdi, son of-Mallukh, **6:45** son of-Chashavyah, son of-Amatshyah, son of-Chilqiyyah, **6:46** son of-Amtsi, son of-Bani, son of-Shemer, **6:47** son of-Machli, son of-Mushi, son of-Merari, son of-Levi.

**6:48** And-their-brothers the-Leviyyim were-given [netunim] for-all the-service [avodat] of-the-dwelling [mishkan] of-the-house of-God [beit ha-Elohim].

**6:49** And-Aharon and-his-sons [were] making-offerings-smoke [maqtirim] upon the-altar [mizbeach] of-the-burnt-offering [ha-olah] and-upon the-altar of-the-incense [ha-qetoret], for-all the-work of-the-holy-of-holies [qodesh ha-qodashim], and-to-make-atonement [ulkhapper] for Yisra'el, according-to-all that Mosheh the-servant of-God [eved ha-Elohim] commanded.

**6:50** And-these [are] the-sons of-Aharon: El'azar his-son, Pinechas his-son, Avishu'a his-son, **6:51** Bukki his-son, Uzzi his-son, Zerachyah his-son, **6:52** Merayot his-son, Amaryah his-son, Achituv his-son, **6:53** Tsadoq his-son, Achima'ats his-son.

**6:54** And-these [are] their-dwellings according-to-their-encampments [tirotam] in-their-border: to-the-sons of-Aharon, of-the-family of-the-Qehati — for to-them was the-lot [ha-goral] — **6:55** and-they-gave to-them Chevron in-the-land of-Yehudah, and-its-pasture-lands [migrasheyha] around-it. **6:56** But-the-field [sedeh] of-the-city and-its-villages they-gave to-Kalev son of-Yefunneh.

**6:57** And-to-the-sons of-Aharon they-gave the-cities of-refuge [arei ha-miqlat]: Chevron, and-Livnah and-its-pasture-lands, and-Yattir, and-Eshtemoa and-its-pasture-lands, **6:58** and-Chilez and-its-pasture-lands, Devir and-its-pasture-lands, **6:59** and-Ashan and-its-pasture-lands, and-Beit-Shemesh and-its-pasture-lands. **6:60** And-from the-tribe of-Binyamin: Geva and-its-pasture-lands, and-Alemet and-its-pasture-lands, and-Anatot and-its-pasture-lands. All their-cities [were] thirteen cities according-to-their-families.

**6:61** And-to-the-sons of-Qehat the-remaining, from the-family of-the-tribe, from the-half of-the-tribe, the-half of-Menasheh, by-lot [ba-goral], ten cities. **6:62** And-to-the-sons of-Gershom according-to-their-families, from the-tribe of-Yissakhar, and-from the-tribe of-Asher, and-from the-tribe of-Naftali, and-from the-tribe of-Menasheh in-ha-Bashan, thirteen cities. **6:63** To-the-sons of-Merari according-to-their-families, from the-tribe of-Re'uven, and-from the-tribe of-Gad, and-from the-tribe of-Zevulun, by-lot, twelve cities.

**6:64** And-gave the-sons of-Yisra'el to-the-Leviyyim the-cities and-their-pasture-lands. **6:65** And-they-gave by-lot from the-tribe of-the-sons of-Yehudah, and-from the-tribe of-the-sons of-Shim'on, and-from the-tribe of-the-sons of-Binyamin, these cities which they-called by-names.

**6:66** And-from the-families of-the-sons of-Qehat, and-the-cities of-their-border were from the-tribe of-Efrayim. **6:67** And-they-gave to-them the-cities of-refuge: Shekhem and-its-pasture-lands in-the-hill-country of-Efrayim, and-Gezer and-its-pasture-lands, **6:68** and-Yoqme'am and-its-pasture-lands, and-Beit-Choron and-its-pasture-lands, **6:69** and-Ayyalon and-its-pasture-lands, and-Gat-Rimmon and-its-pasture-lands.

**6:70** And-from the-half of-the-tribe of-Menasheh: Aner and-its-pasture-lands, and-Bil'am and-its-pasture-lands, for-the-family of-the-sons of-Qehat the-remaining.

**6:71** To-the-sons of-Gershom, from the-family of-the-half of-the-tribe of-Menasheh: Golan in-ha-Bashan and-its-pasture-lands, and-Ashtarot and-its-pasture-lands. **6:72** And-from the-tribe of-Yissakhar: Qedesh and-its-pasture-lands, Dovrat and-its-pasture-lands, **6:73** and-Ramot and-its-pasture-lands, and-Anem and-its-pasture-lands. **6:74** And-from the-tribe of-Asher: Mashal and-its-pasture-lands, and-Avdon and-its-pasture-lands, **6:75** and-Chuqoq and-its-pasture-lands, and-Rechov and-its-pasture-lands. **6:76** And-from the-tribe of-Naftali: Qedesh in-ha-Galil and-its-pasture-lands, and-Chammon and-its-pasture-lands, and-Qiryatayim and-its-pasture-lands.

**6:77** To-the-sons of-Merari the-remaining, from the-tribe of-Zevulun: Rimmono and-its-pasture-lands, Tavor and-its-pasture-lands. **6:78** And-from-beyond the-Yarden [at] Yericho, to-the-east of-the-Yarden, from the-tribe of-Re'uven: Betser in-the-wilderness and-its-pasture-lands, and-Yahtsah and-its-pasture-lands, **6:79** and-Qedemot and-its-pasture-lands, and-Meifa'at and-its-pasture-lands. **6:80** And-from the-tribe of-Gad: Ramot in-ha-Gil'ad and-its-pasture-lands, and-Machanayim and-its-pasture-lands, **6:81** and-Cheshbon and-its-pasture-lands, and-Ya'zer and-its-pasture-lands.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1-15 — The priestly line:** Twenty-three generations from Levi to the exile — a chain of high priests from Aaron through Jehozadak, who went into Babylonian captivity (v.15). This is the backbone of legitimate priestly succession.

**v.10 — "he is the one who served as priest":** An unusual interruption in the genealogy to identify the Azariah who served in Solomon's temple. The Chronicler marks the temple connection explicitly.

**v.28 — "Vashni":** The name is problematic. In 1 Samuel 8:2, Samuel's firstborn is "Joel." *Vashni* may be a corruption of *vehasheni* ("and the second"), suggesting the original text read "Joel the firstborn, and Abijah the second."

**v.31-32 — Music ministry:** David's appointment of singers marks a turning point — the Levites move from tabernacle service to temple music. The three chief musicians (Heman, Asaph, Ethan) represent the three Levitical clans.

**v.49 — Aaronic distinction:** The Chronicler carefully separates priestly (Aaronic) from Levitical service. Only Aaron's sons handle the altars and the holy of holies. The Levites serve the tabernacle but do not approach the altar.

*— EMET*
